title: Piri-piri Sauce
preamble:
Ingredients:-
4
cayenne chillies, cleaned and finely chopped
juice
of one Lemon
3
cloves of garlic, minced
one
tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley
one
tablespoon Paprika
4
tablespoons of Olive Oil
1
teaspoon Salt

4
cayenne chillies, cleaned and finely chopped
juice
of one Lemon
3
cloves of garlic, minced
one
tablespoon of chopped fresh parsley
one
tablespoon Paprika
4
tablespoons of Olive Oil
1
teaspoon Salt

Method:-
Remove stems and seeds from chillies.
Grind and mix all ingredients to a fine paste by hand or use a blender or food processor.
If you want to go hotter add ground cayenne pepper or seeds from chillies.
Cook in a hot frying-pan for a few minutes.
Store in a sterilized jar in the refrigerator.
The flavour will develope over the following week.
